An '''officer''' was part of the crew of the ''[[Far Orbit]]'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] up until after the ship's crew [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutineed]] from under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. He challenged a [[Unidentified career pirate officer|pirate officer]] to a duel.<ref name="PW">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=Preparing for War}}</ref>
